quality_state.honest_summary: Structural goals of N1 (stair/lowland/terrace logic, no broad stair) and N2 (functional zoning) were built and held across all review rounds. The far-shore hard gate failed for three rounds until root-caused to the compositor mist amount (To Max 0.125) and warm fog color; after fix, blind reviews E/F confirmed far_shore_hard_brown ok and reviewer G passed the light combo. However the asset-precision layer remains below the 85 line: grass blades read as upright stalk bundles, the tree crown lacks the reference's dense amber mass, paving lacks wear/roughness distribution, and several equipment boxes read as featureless. Five blind review rounds scored 55.3/55.3, 67.8/61.3, 60.6/61.3, 65.4/51.6, 65.4(uncertain G)/51.6(H) - all below 85; no round was fabricated or suppressed.
